reason: Both identify the same root cause at the same location: the \"7d\" preset uses daysAgo(7) instead of the correct daysAgo(6) (i.e., missing the n-1 adjustment applied to 30d/90d), and because the SQL window is inclusive with `to` fixed at today, this yields an 8-day span instead of the intended 7-day span. The reviewer's summary is a paraphrase (framed as \"not fixed\" relative to the 30d/90d fix) of the identical runtime misbehavior, not a different bug or vague complaint.
